value.rationale: The natural continuous uncertainty family contains all positive finite and general Cauchy mixtures, even with unknown total normalizing mass when error is measured relatively. The theorem gives a sharp exact worst-case Fourier alias energy (equivalently worst relative normalizer variance for unnormalized positive mixtures), unique best reference among every Cauchy center/scale, active-endpoint transition, a real narrowing–widening cusp, and an N-uniform design for arbitrarily fine sampling. This is a complete structural extremal classification, not just an exactness test or an arbitrary finite slice. Its known baseline Fourier alias identity is not claimed as valuable novelty.
